verdict.rationale: kitty is a locally installed terminal emulator with no hosted service, so choosing a storage region or data residency is not a meaningful axis for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows kitty storing user data in any cloud location that could have a selectable region. The privacy and update-check complaints in the community items concern other topics and do not bear on residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
